title: better foods plus+
description: using name independant texture with some of the foods in the game
body:
This is a texture pack that uses name dependant textures to some food items in the game there might be some errors so be free to help me spot them for me.

item names:

steak: chocolate bar, hamburgur

golden apple: golden candy apple

apple: candy apple

raw salmon: sushi

cooked salmon: deepfried sushi

raw cod: california roll

glow berries: glow berrie juice

sweet berries: sweet berrie juice

baked potato: fries, poutine
